$comment: Sanctioned async-state violations (ADR-032 §5): the closed set of sites where a feature or store owns a UI projection of a backend event that BRIDGE_INVALIDATIONS cannot express. Each entry has the baseline's identity (rule, file, specifier or symbol) plus the written reason the owner accepted.

frontend/scripts/check-async-state-gates.mjs passes a violation named here, fails on an exception that no longer occurs (the message names the entry to delete), and refuses to run when an exception has no reason.

This is not debt: frontend/async-state-baseline.json holds the debt. Never add an exception without an owner decision; new code reads through useBridgeQuery / useBridgeMutation and BRIDGE_INVALIDATIONS (skill bridge-data).

exceptions.reason: The Activity feed owns its freshness here: a burst of recorder rows refreshes the first feed page and the counts once, 1000 ms after the burst goes quiet, keeping the older pages already loaded. BRIDGE_INVALIDATIONS invalidates a key on every event and would re-read every page per row.

The run story owns its freshness here: only stored rows of the selected run trigger a re-read, 250 ms after the burst goes quiet, and a failed refresh keeps the ready story on screen. A registry rule cannot filter by run id or debounce.

UI-state projection: an archive drops the archived rows in place from the keyset pages already loaded. Freshness of the unread count is owned by BRIDGE_INVALIDATIONS; invalidating the pages would reset the user's paging and scroll.
An ephemeral backend command, not data: a pressed navigation token tells the window which route to open. There is no query whose freshness it changes.
Push toasts are a UI projection of each pushed notification. Freshness of the notification queries is owned in parallel by the BRIDGE_INVALIDATIONS rule on the same event.
Dismisses the toasts of archived notifications, a UI projection. Freshness of the unread count is owned in parallel by the BRIDGE_INVALIDATIONS rule on the same event.

Ends the matching progress the season store shows while a run is live, a UI projection. The authoritative reload of the intake rows on a finished run is owned by BRIDGE_INVALIDATIONS (SEASON_ANIMES_KEY).
Per-row matching progress is a UI projection of each progress event; it is not stored data a query could re-read.
Starts the progress of a matching run with its total, a UI projection of the event; it is not stored data a query could re-read.
